about: Bonus plans for ordinary staff (WorkerBonus.swift), built on the monthly targets and the yearly budget of ManagerTargets. Every figure is a game design value, not taken from a source; none is a money amount. A level pays three things, each a share of the person's monthly pay: `targetRate` for every monthly target the company met (of three, the same judgement as a manager's bonus), `yearEndMonths` months of pay when the year's sales and profit budget is met (pro rata to the weeks they served in the year), `performanceRate` each month to people whose skill is at or above the team's average, but only in a month the company did not make a loss. Everything is paid through payroll, so it carries the employer's charges like wages. `expect` are the figures used to show what a plan is likely to cost a month before it is agreed. `smoothing` is how fast the average bonus a person counts as pay follows the months. `happyWeeks` is how long a bonus paid keeps a person pleased.

levels.name: No bonus plan
levels.detail: Pay is the salary or hourly pay only.

levels.name: Standard plan
levels.detail: A little for every target the company meets, a half month at year end, a small reward for the best.

levels.name: High plan
levels.detail: More for every target, a full month at year end and a real reward for the best.
